segments.comment: Independent source-reaching C33 wake/attack witness. The leprechaun is initially asleep from makemon.c, the tin whistle invokes use_whistle() and wake_nearby(), then do_attack reaches its rn2(7) gate at step 50 and draws 4. The nonzero draw skips m_move; this recording does not evidence the movement call/return branch.

comment: Independent C33 wake/attack witness. Source sets new leprechauns sleeping; a tin whistle wakes this target. The C trace then reaches do_attack's rn2(7) gate and draws 4, so the dodge m_move arm is skipped.
